blocks.html: An object used to allow specifying flexible queries with and/or conditions.

types.name: id
types.description: The IDs to filter the provider identity by.

types.name: entity_id
types.description: Filter the provider identities by the ID of the provider identity they are linked to.

types.name: auth_identity_id
types.description: Filter the provider identities by the ID of the auth identity they are linked to.

types.name: provider
types.description: The provider handle to filter the provider identity by.

types.name: provider_metadata
types.description: Holds custom data related to the provider in key-value pairs.

types.name: user_metadata
types.description: Holds custom data related to the user in key-value pairs.

types.name: $and
types.description: An array of filters to apply on the entity, where each item in the array is joined with an "and" condition.
